title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
summary: 本課聚焦以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度。從導向道測量角度誤差建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把不平順波長轉換與理想吸力模型的適用邊界連成可驗證的介面，最後以有限合格紀錄的外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty. Start with angular error in guideway surveying to define physical or information boundaries, connect converting irregularity wavelengths with limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating finite successful records. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究導向道測量角度誤差。原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。敏感度只改 distance=40 至 44 m，輸出變為 1.1 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究精度帳的獨立與相關成分：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate angular error in guideway surveying. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. For sensitivity, change only distance=40 to 44 m; the output becomes 1.1 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate independent and correlated precision terms: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angular error in guideway surveying” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導向道測量角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Angular error in guideway surveying” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 不同時間量測的導梁可能因溫度而改變長度，先定義比較所用的參考狀態。自由均勻伸長只是基準模型，熱梯度和拘束須另外追蹤。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁溫差與基準時刻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measurements at different times may capture thermal length changes, so define the comparison reference state first.
